title: Silulumanzi Bursary Programme 2027
sector: Water industry — engineering, IT, quantity surveying, environmental science, water care and technical trades
qualification_level: Degrees and diplomas at an accredited South African tertiary institution
description: Silulumanzi, the water and sanitation concession operator in Mbombela, invites Grade 12 learners to apply for its 2027 bursary programme. It covers registration, tuition, accommodation and prescribed books for degrees such as electrical, chemical, civil and mechanical engineering, IT, quantity surveying and biology, and for diplomas and technical programmes such as environmental science, water care, millwright and instrumentation. Preference goes to applicants from Silulumanzi's concession areas (Mbombela, KaNyamazane, Matsulu, Tekwane), previously disadvantaged individuals, women and persons with disabilities. Applications close on 30 November 2026. Confirm every detail on Silulumanzi's page before applying.
eligibility: Grade 12 with a Bachelor Pass and Level 6 in Mathematics and Science
Proof of admission or acceptance at an accredited South African tertiary institution
Interest in a career in the water industry
Preference for the Silulumanzi concession areas, previously disadvantaged individuals, women and persons with disabilities
documents_needed: Certified copy of South African ID
Proof of residence and household income
verification_notes: Details come from a third-party article (setacareers.co.za, not a SETA). It names the Silulumanzi Training and Development page as the official source; I did not open that page, so the closing date (30 Nov 2026), subject list and criteria are NOT yet confirmed. The article says applications are physical, not online: forms from the Silulumanzi Customer Care offices in KaNyamazane, Matsulu and Mbombela, posted to The Bursary Department, Human Resources, P.O. Box 12753, Mbombela, 1200, or hand-delivered. The documents list above is typical, and the article says the checklist on the current form governs, so check it against the form. Leave verified false until the official page confirms the date and criteria.
